title: Match partition lanes to delivery semantics
description: Size producer and consumer capacity independently, then choose the subscription contract that preserves the workload's ordering and ownership invariant.

workloads.label: Independent jobs
workloads.detail: Every message can run on any consumer; aggregate throughput is the priority.

workloads.label: Ordered per customer
workloads.detail: Different customers may run in parallel, but one customer's events must stay ordered.

workloads.label: Active with standby
workloads.detail: Each partition needs one active consumer and another process ready to take over.

workloads.label: Single attached consumer
workloads.detail: The whole subscription must have exactly one attached consumer.

subscriptions.label: Exclusive
subscriptions.detail: Only one consumer may attach to the subscription, including across a partitioned topic.

subscriptions.label: Failover
subscriptions.detail: Multiple consumers attach, with one active consumer selected for each partition.

subscriptions.label: Shared
subscriptions.detail: All consumers can receive; messages are distributed without an ordering guarantee.

subscriptions.label: Key_Shared
subscriptions.detail: All consumers can receive, while one key is assigned to one consumer at a time.
